data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 系好的包裹
data.description: 她检查收件人的名字，把松开的纸绳重新系紧，才将包裹放到待送架上。
data.promptProse: At a busy courier sorting station, Angelina secures a thick parcel wrapped in heavy kraft paper with sturdy cross-tied hemp twine. Beside her work counter sit a mechanical brass scale, postage ink stamps, and neatly organized stacks of delivery manifests.
data.animaCaption: Knotted hemp twine pulled taut around the parcel, she affixes a priority destination stamp with swift, practiced efficiency.
